author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: There are something Opus 4.6 still can't do, even though the acceptance criteria is crystal clear.   I asked it to 100% clone the function, the look and feel of a single page in a website from screenshot.  It just can't get it right.   The output still look very fake to my human eye, although it insists they look the same.
